'''Plexis''' was an astronomical object<ref name="GG10" /> located in the [[Plexis system/Legends|Plexis system]], a part of the [[Southern Core]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The home offices of [[House Neuvalis]], a chapter house of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]], were located on Plexis, leading to the celestial body being considered the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the house.<ref name="GG10" /> Plexis was listed as the Neuvalis headquarters in an entry for the house included in the [[Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook]].<ref name="BHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Plexis was first mentioned in the [[1994]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]'', written by [[Rick D. Stuart]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG10" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Plexis [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Plexis itself, in grid square L-13.<ref name="TEA" />
